title: HexVidia
body:
Do you enjoy the limitless creative enhancements AI slop has so far brought to our lives?

Do you think that the sacrifice of 10 gorbillion sticks of RAM is justified for the creation of AGI?

Do you want to never have to write a single hex pattern again?

Then this mod is for you!

------

Just a silly little april fools thing I made. Mixins into the ravenmind functions to make them cost media, and adds a function that generates random hex patterns, thats sadly it. Alongside some humorous text.

------

No AI's were utilized in the creation of this abomination 

Ill keep this closed source since the code is a huge mess from being rushed
